title: Liveness code written with wrong digits
description: Replace a bicycle chain; the after photo shows a liveness code, but with the wrong digits.

criteria.label: Chain is new/clean and fully seated on the sprockets
Chain tension looks correct (no excessive sag)
Drivetrain is lubricated without excess oil
Work area and bike left tidy

notes: MANUAL §9.5 wrong-code case. In the AFTER frame write a different 4-digit number (e.g. 1111) than this case livenessCode. cL is required -> FAIL high-confidence = REJECTED, NOT_VISIBLE/uncertain = HUMAN_REVIEW.
